name: mobile-audit-final
description: Mobile audit final pass: corrected touch sweep (accounts for ::after hit-expanders) on catalog + inspector + plan toolbar + finish tabs + share; plus lighting-moods row and plan hackability overlay legibility.

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; (function(){ const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.setManualHour?.(19); s.setUiMode?.('pro'); s.reresolveFeatureFlags?.(); })()

steps.name: arm-and-select
steps.eval: (() => { const s=window.__store.getState(); s.setCatalogOpen(false); const it=s.items.find(i=>true); if(it) s.selectItem(it.id); })()

steps.name: goto-lighting
steps.eval: (() => { const rail=[...document.querySelectorAll('.m-rail button, .m-sheet-rail button, [role=tab], button')].map(b=>({b,l:(b.getAttribute('aria-label')||b.title||b.textContent||'')})); const hit=rail.find(x=>/light|scene|mood|palette|sun/i.test(x.l)); if(hit){ hit.b.click(); return hit.l } return 'RAIL:'+rail.slice(0,10).map(x=>x.l).join('|') })()

steps.name: open-plan-tools
steps.eval: (() => { const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('.plan-header button, button')].find(x=>(x.className||'').includes('m-menu-btn')); if(b){ b.click(); return 'menu-opened' } return 'NO-MENU-BTN' })()

steps.name: toggle-hack
steps.eval: (() => { const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('button, [role=menuitem], [role=option]')].find(x=>/hackab|structur|demolish|load.?bearing/i.test((x.textContent||'')+(x.getAttribute('aria-label')||''))); if(b){ b.click(); return b.textContent||b.getAttribute('aria-label') } return 'HACK-NOT-FOUND' })()
